content: Playtronic Games is getting ready to launch Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair: Definitive Edition as a free update on PlayStation 5, Switch 2, and PC on December 15th. Unfortunately for Xbox owners, the developer says it “can’t commit to any additional platforms for the foreseeable future.” In a statement posted on X, Playtronic said that it understands the frustration some players may feel, but that bringing the Definitive Edition to Xbox just isn’t viable “given the technological challenges and costs,” and reminded people that they’re a small team. [Media: https://twitter.com/PlaytonicGames/status/2126330360971612535] Some, like The Game Business editor-in-chief Christopher Dring, have speculated that Xbox’s smaller install base has made it harder for some indie devs to “financially justify” launching on Xbox. Others, like John Linneman of Digital Foundry, have countered that Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair: Definitive Edition is ultimately a minor update and pointed out that the Xbox Series X version was already available in native 4K, unlike the PS4 and Switch versions.

chineseContent: Playtronic Games 正准备于 12 月 15 日在 PlayStation 5、Switch 2 和 PC 上推出《Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair: Definitive Edition》免费更新。不幸的是，对于 Xbox 用户来说，开发商表示“在可预见的未来无法承诺任何其他平台”。 Playtronic 在 X 上发布的一份声明中表示，它理解一些玩家可能会感到的挫败感，但“考虑到技术挑战和成本”，将最终版引入 Xbox 是不可行的，并提醒人们他们只是一个小团队。 [媒体：https://twitter.com/PlaytonicGames/status/2126330360971612535] 一些人，比如《游戏商业》主编 Christopher Dring，推测 Xbox 较小的安装基础使得一些独立开发者更难“在经济上证明”在 Xbox 上的推出。 Digital Foundry 的约翰·林尼曼 (John Linneman) 等人则反驳说，《尤卡莱莉与不可能的巢穴：最终版》最终只是一个小更新，并指出 Xbox Series X 版本已经提供了原生 4K 格式，与 PS4 和 Switch 版本不同。
